description: The signed-in account: action='status' (default: email, what is kept, keys), 'plan' (what the free beta includes: the keyless trial and the free account; nothing is charged), 'usage', 'keys' (list; never the key itself), 'revoke_key' with key_prefix, 'export' (everything held), 'delete' with confirm_email=<the account email> (mails a confirmation link; deletion happens on the click). Not signed in: says how to sign in, and 'plan' still shows what the free beta includes.

action.description: status | plan | usage | keys | revoke_key | export | delete
action.title: Action

confirm_email.description: With action='delete': the account's email, typed back by the user
confirm_email.title: Confirm Email

key_prefix.description: With action='revoke_key': the key's prefix as action='keys' lists it (rek_xxxxxx)
key_prefix.title: Key Prefix

session.description: The `session` value the sign-in returned. Pass it on every call in this conversation, so the sign-in survives however this client handles connections; omit it when the user connected with Sign in (OAuth) or a key.
session.title: Session

tier.description: With action='plan': not needed during the beta — everything is free and there is no paid plan to choose
tier.title: Tier
